- Total revenue reached £254.2k TW versus £195.1k LW, a WoW gain of 30.3%, and versus £229.1k LY, a YoY gain of 10.9%.
- Total units came in at 146,905 TW against 104,327 LW, up 40.8% WoW, while total orders reached 430 TW, up 3.4% WoW.
- United Kingdom ranked 1 TW with £196.5k revenue, a 77.3% share of total TW revenue, on 103,879 units and 391 orders.
- Netherlands posted £29.5k revenue TW, an 11.6% share of total TW revenue.
- EIRE posted £13.8k revenue TW, a 5.4% share of total TW revenue, and led WoW growth at +91.1%.
- Netherlands recorded the largest WoW revenue gain at £29,458.10 and the best YoY move at +7,641.5%.
- Germany recorded the largest WoW revenue drop at £3,037.98.
- United Kingdom showed the softest WoW growth at +8.1% and the weakest YoY change at -8.0%.
